# The MacEx Journal

> Practical Mac file organization and productivity articles by MacEx.

- [How to Find Large Files on Your Mac](https://macex.app/blog/find-large-files-on-mac/): Running out of Mac storage? Find your biggest files using Storage settings and Finder, then remove what you no longer need without deleting the wrong thing.
- [A file naming system for Mac that you can actually keep using](https://macex.app/blog/mac-file-naming-system/): Make project files easier to recognize with a simple subject, date, and version pattern. Includes examples for invoices, drafts, screenshots, and shared work.
- [Finder Smart Folders: keep a project view without moving your files](https://macex.app/blog/finder-smart-folders/): Build a saved Finder search for active work, understand what Smart Folders actually store, and choose rules that stay useful as your projects grow.
- [How to find a file on your Mac when you forgot its name](https://macex.app/blog/find-files-on-mac-without-filename/): Turn the clues you remember into a useful search: file type, approximate date, likely location, and content. A practical workflow for Finder and MacEx.
